states.claim: cc is advanced past the XCL_* opcode byte to point at the first class item; ccbegin records that first-item address.
When the class has an XCL_MAP bitmap, cc is advanced by 32 bytes to skip the bitmap storage.
states.evidence:
L26: if (cc[-1] & XCL_MAP)
L29: cc += 32 / sizeof(PCRE2_UCHAR);

states.claim: cc is reset to ccbegin, the start of the class item list, before code generation.
cc is advanced past the bitmap storage again after the bitmap handling block.
states.evidence:
L174: cc += 32 / sizeof(PCRE2_UCHAR);
L210: cc += 32 / sizeof(PCRE2_UCHAR);

states.claim: cc is reset to ccbegin after each Unicode property scan loop.
cc is advanced by two PCRE2_UCHAR units after each XCL_PROP/XCL_NOTPROP property item.
cc is advanced past each XCL_SINGLE/XCL_RANGE item via GETCHARINCTEST.

states.claim: other_cases is advanced through the caseless-set entries during scanning and code generation.

values.claim: When XCL_MAP is set, cc is advanced by 32/sizeof(PCRE2_UCHAR) to skip the 32-byte bitmap.
values.evidence:
L26: if (cc[-1] & XCL_MAP)
L29: cc += 32 / sizeof(PCRE2_UCHAR);

values.claim: min is initialized to READ_CHAR_MAX and max to 256; scanning XCL_SINGLE/XCL_RANGE updates min/max to the smallest/largest character code seen.
If XCL_MAP is present, min is set to 0 before scanning.
values.evidence: L28: min = 0;

values.claim: For PT_CLIST, max/min are updated over the caseless set until NOTACHAR.
For non-PT_CLIST Unicode properties, max is reset to READ_CHAR_MAX and min to 0.
values.evidence:
L73: max = READ_CHAR_MAX;
L74: min = 0;

values.claim: For a non-map class, TMP2 = TMP1 - min and the out-of-range test compares TMP2 against max - min.
values.evidence:
L178: OP2(SLJIT_SUB, TMP2, 0, TMP1, 0, SLJIT_IMM, min);
L179: add_jump(compiler, (cc[-1] & XCL_NOT) == 0 ? backtracks : &found, CMP(SLJIT_GREATER, TMP2, 0, SLJIT_IMM, max - min));

values.claim: Bitmap lookup uses TMP2 = TMP1 & 0x7, TMP1 = TMP1 >> 3, then loads the byte at cc + TMP1 and tests bit (1 << TMP2).
In the XCL_HASPROP+XCL_MAP path, the same bitmap index computation is used: TMP2 = TMP1 & 0x7, TMP1 = TMP1 >> 3, byte load from cc + TMP1, bit test with (1 << TMP2).

UCD lookup: TMP2 = (TMP1 >> UCD_BLOCK_SHIFT) << 1, load u16 from PRIV(ucd_stage1)+TMP2, TMP1 = (TMP1 & UCD_BLOCK_MASK) + (TMP2 << UCD_BLOCK_SHIFT), then load u16 from PRIV(ucd_stage2) indexed by TMP1.
Record offset is computed as TMP1 = TMP2 << 3 and TMP2 = (TMP2 << 2) + TMP1, i.e. TMP2 = 12 * record_index.
Bidi class is extracted as u16 from ucd_records+scriptx_bidiclass offset, then shifted right by UCD_BIDICLASS_SHIFT.
values.evidence:
L244: OP1(SLJIT_MOV_U16, TMP1, 0, SLJIT_MEM1(TMP2), (sljit_sw)PRIV(ucd_records) + SLJIT_OFFSETOF(ucd_record, scriptx_bidiclass));
L245: OP2(SLJIT_LSHR, TMP1, 0, TMP1, 0, SLJIT_IMM, UCD_BIDICLASS_SHIFT);

values.claim: Boolean property bits are extracted as u16 from ucd_records+bprops, masked with UCD_BPROPS_MASK, then shifted left by 2.
Boolean property test indexes PRIV(ucd_boolprop_sets) at (cc[1] >> 5) and tests bit (1 << (cc[1] & 0x1f)) at offset TMP1.
values.evidence: L310: OP2U(SLJIT_AND32 | SLJIT_SET_Z, SLJIT_MEM1(TMP1), (sljit_sw)(PRIV(ucd_boolprop_sets) + (cc[1] >> 5)), SLJIT_IMM, (sljit_sw)1 << (cc[1] & 0x1f));

values.claim: Script is loaded as u8 from ucd_records+script offset.
values.evidence: L322: OP1(SLJIT_MOV_U8, TMP1, 0, SLJIT_MEM1(TMP2), (sljit_sw)PRIV(ucd_records) + SLJIT_OFFSETOF(ucd_record, script));

values.claim: Script extension is extracted as u16 from ucd_records+scriptx_bidiclass, masked with UCD_SCRIPTX_MASK, then shifted left by 2.
Script extension test indexes PRIV(ucd_script_sets) at (cc[1] >> 5) and tests bit (1 << (cc[1] & 0x1f)) at offset TMP1.
values.evidence: L421: OP2U(SLJIT_AND32 | SLJIT_SET_Z, SLJIT_MEM1(TMP1), (sljit_sw)(PRIV(ucd_script_sets) + (cc[1] >> 5)), SLJIT_IMM, (sljit_sw)1 << (cc[1] & 0x1f));

values.claim: Chartype is loaded as u8 from ucd_records+chartype offset into typereg.
values.evidence: L446: OP1(SLJIT_MOV_U8, typereg, 0, SLJIT_MEM1(TMP2), (sljit_sw)PRIV(ucd_records) + SLJIT_OFFSETOF(ucd_record, chartype));

values.claim: Character comparisons use (c - charoffset) as the immediate compared against TMP1.
SET_CHAR_OFFSET(c) sets charoffset to c for the following range comparison.
values.evidence: L492: SET_CHAR_OFFSET(c);

values.claim: SET_TYPE_OFFSET(c) sets typeoffset to c; type comparisons use (constant - typeoffset) against typereg.
PT_CLIST optimization: when other_cases[1]^other_cases[0] is a power of 2, TMP2 = TMP1 | (other_cases[1]^other_cases[0]) (or TMP1+charoffset then OR), then compared against other_cases[1].

PT_CLIST optimization: when other_cases[2]^other_cases[1] is a power of 2, TMP2 = TMP1 | (other_cases[2]^other_cases[1]) (or TMP1+charoffset then OR), compared against other_cases[2], and TMP1 compared against (other_cases[0]-charoffset).
PT_CLIST fallback compares TMP1 against (*other_cases++ - charoffset) for each remaining caseless-set entry until NOTACHAR.

PT_UCNC compares TMP1 against CHAR_DOLLAR_SIGN, CHAR_COMMERCIAL_AT, CHAR_GRAVE_ACCENT minus charoffset, then against 0xd7ff-charoffset after SET_CHAR_OFFSET(0xa0), and against 0xe000 after SET_CHAR_OFFSET(0).
PT_PXGRAPH/PT_PXPRINT compare TMP1 against 0x2069-0x2066, 0x061c-0x2066, 0x180e-0x2066 after SET_CHAR_OFFSET(0x2066).
PT_PXPUNCT compares TMP1 against 0x7f after SET_CHAR_OFFSET(0).
values.evidence:
L710: SET_CHAR_OFFSET(0);
L711: OP2U(SLJIT_SUB | SLJIT_SET_LESS_EQUAL, TMP1, 0, SLJIT_IMM, 0x7f);

values.claim: In 32-bit non-utf mode, TMP1 is replaced by UNASSIGNED_UTF_CHAR when TMP1 < MAX_UTF_CODE_POINT+1.
values.evidence:
L222: jump = CMP(SLJIT_LESS, TMP1, 0, SLJIT_IMM, MAX_UTF_CODE_POINT + 1);
L223: OP1(SLJIT_MOV, TMP1, 0, SLJIT_IMM, UNASSIGNED_UTF_CHAR);
